API ReferenceZscaler Cloud & Branch Connector APICloud & Branch Connector GroupsUpdate Ec VM Interface
Update Ec VM Interface
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/ztw/api/v1/ecgroup/:ecgroupId/vm/:vmId/intf/:intfId

Updates the Cloud or Branch Connector interface within a specific VM based on the provided interface ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
ecgroupId
int32
REQUIRED

The Cloud or Branch Connector group ID.

vmId
int32
REQUIRED

The ID of the VM.

intfId
int32
REQUIRED

The interface ID

APPLICATION/JSON
BODY
carpHAEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether high availability (HA) via Common Address Redundancy Protocol (CARP) is enabled for the interface.

carpHAPreferredOn
boolean

Specifies whether the interface is marked as the preferred CARP interface for handling traffic when high availability is active.

carpHAState
string

Specifies the operational state of the CARP HA.

Possible values: [INIT, ACTIVE, STANDBY]

carpId
int32

The ID of the HA pair device.

carpVip
string

The virtual IP address of the interface.

configuredUplinkState
string

Specifies the uplink mode as set by the configuration.

Possible values: [INIT, ACTIVE, STANDBY]

currentUplinkState
string

Specifies the current operational status of the uplink mode.

Possible values: [INIT, ACTIVE, STANDBY]

description
string

The description of the CARP interface.

dhcpEnabled
boolean

Indicates whether dynamic host configuration protocol (DHCP) is enabled for the interface.

dhcpServer
object
ecVmId
int32

The ID of the VM associated with the interface.

id
int32

The interface ID.

interfaceType
string

Specifies the type of network interface

Possible values: [INTF_TYPE_WAN, INTF_TYPE_LAN]

ipInfo
object
linkScore
int32

The quality link score of the uplink.

mtu
int32

The permissible IP Maximum Transmission Units (MTU) of the parent interface.

portId
string

The ID of the port.

Possible values: [GE1, GE2, GE3, GE4, GE5, GE6, GE7, GE8]

portStatusUp
boolean

Indicates whether the physical port associated with the interface is operational.

shutdownOn
boolean

Indicates whether the interface is shut down.

vlanId
int32

The ID of the virtual local area network (VLAN).

Responses
​
default

Default response. To learn more, see API Response Codes and Error Messages.

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
